tasks.title: Supplies ledger, computed cover and planning ports
tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, in that order, then all reads. This is a fresh-session assignment. The frozen E32 design is not edited. Read docs/build/E32/PLAN.md, including Design deviations and coordinator handoffs B01 to B09. The canonical docs/requests/E32.md does not exist at planning time; require its coordinator-filed decisions before dependent work. A request in the frozen design or this plan is not an accepted contract. Recheck the tree and every docs/build/*/tasks.json before creating an owned file. No hub, UI, eval or generated hub contracts exist at planning time; pharmacy is already implemented and read only. Never overwrite another coder, edit another task's files, add unlisted initializers, amend the product package, or copy a provider implementation. Propose missing shared changes to the coordinator; do not invent a port, wire type, table or command. No git. English, no em/en dashes or spaced hyphen dash.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock/TimeInput/ClockCorrections with corrected observed time and process epochs; 5.3 MissionClock for labels only; 5.4 Quantity(Decimal, Unit), UnitRegistry and accepted WireUnitConverter mappings; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope on HTTP; 5.6 ConfigReleaseReader/ReleaseHandle, ReleaseCheck/ActivationGuard/TemplateRenderer and immutable pins; 5.7 StorageSession, UnitOfWorkFactory/UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot, DomainEventBus, audiences and atomic replication declarations; 5.8 CommandIdentity/IdempotencyStore/ResultVisibility/AcceptedReceipt; 5.9 complete reference-only AuditEntry/hash chain; 5.10 scheduler deadlines, 5.10.1 TaskQueue/TaskRunner generations and 5.10.2 EvaluationIsolation; 5.11 typed HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry/register and startup phases. No replacement transaction, idempotency ledger, clock, retry loop or queue. SYSTEM 6 supplies uv --project hub, pnpm, guarded generated Python/TypeScript models, static discovery and import-linter. SYSTEM 8.1 to 8.6 governs canonical seams, guidance, object/field privacy, current clinical authority, local custody and durability; SYSTEM 9/10 supplies hard dependencies and kernel.testing. Backend features talk only through application ports. UI uses @crew-health/contracts and E03/E20 shell/offline mechanisms.

Write critical-path tests first. Fixtures come from opened configuration/examples through explicit test/demo profiles, never hand-typed clinical content or production fallback. Every test traces an E32-T ID and R/V/D or invariant. Every parser/rule/unit conversion gets property tests and every module gets a non-safety content-edit proof. Clinical arithmetic also needs independently sourced golden expectations. Bounds, external calls and subprocess deadlines use registered finite settings, never dropped accepted facts. No clinical text/value in logs, generic caches, fingerprints without keyed protection, replication or error bodies. Current object and field grants apply before reads, mutation, saved-result replay, event/task delivery and exports. Officer status and help membership alone do not grant a chart. The assistant cannot compute/confirm a dose or alter safety state.

Real-stack acceptance uses the hub HTTP API through create_app(settings) with real configuration/authentication/composition and a real SQLite database in a temporary directory, or Playwright against that hub. No hub mocks, dependency overrides, fake repositories, direct-SQL seeding or browser API interception. Optional external model/devices/link are absent or use documented adapter fakes. Unbuilt providers use their exact protocols and E01 kernel.testing during unit/port development only; those tests do not establish assembled acceptance. A missing required provider/scenario/tool is a blocked gate, not skip/xfail/pass. Keep independent provider counterpart tests. Done means all assigned test IDs, exact owned gates, shared contract/safety gates, independent review and CI pass with evidence. After a bug fix run the full hub/UI suites; report all failures. Coordinator records AI-USE-LOG.md rows outside task ownership.

Build only the supplies backend concern, E32-01 to E32-04: E32 sections 1 to 6.1, supplies parts of 8 to 12 and section 15 steps 1 to 5/7. The owned source list is expanded verbatim from E32 section 13 (docs/tdd/E32.md:857). All backend unit, integration, property, contract and HTTP end-to-end tests belong in hub/tests/supplies, including the named fixtures.py from section 12. T2 owns medicines; T3 owns UI. E27 owns the four kit-map keys' actual file/content merge and all planning/card shell files; request B05 supplies them. Do not create config/kit-map.json, authoring/supplies/kit-map-supplies.json, warning-rules, provider tests, eval scenarios or supplies/module.py. B01 must allocate the missing registration file and reissue ownership before real-stack acceptance. No work is silently delegated to E01 assembly edits.

Implement E32 3.2 SupplyDef, StockRow, SupplyNeed, PartitionKey, SupplyUseRecord, StockLevel and CoverRow, plus the errors of 6.1, using kernel Actor/Quantity/Unit. Parse display supply units through E32 section 3's annotation rule with UnitRegistry, never a clinical conversion table. Enforce INV-S1 to INV-S14: inclusive inventory; active physical packed stock minus append-only consumed quantity; unknown stays null; cover floor over largest applicable pinned per-use; correct text precedence; non-consumables never consumed; atomic multi-need step use; no unit reinterpretation or negative balance. All stages/return.prepare and plan/step environment applicability count as specified, excluding rejected plans. Supplies and uses partition by mission, origin, environment and local custody. Persist original capture context, corrected observed time and partition revision so late input cannot overwrite a newer fact. SYSTEM 8.5's interim is one local site per environment, never a copied stock row as write authority. Require Ownership where the approved schema carries custody; cross-site transfer remains disabled until its exact schema/registration is available.

Implement GetSupplyCover, RecordSupplyUse, RecordStepUses, CoverPlanning and with_added in E32 4.1/4.3. StockReader.stock(environment_id) returns Mapping[str, StockLevel] in the caller's snapshot. SupplyLedgerPort.record_step_uses uses the caller UoW, pinned_release_id and validated SupplyNeed values, never its own commit. B03 must resolve E28's extra occurrence parameter (docs/tdd/E28.md:334) and requested SupplyCoverPort.uses_after_one against E32's older signature before either is implemented; no local variants. Import E27's exact KitMapContext, SupplyAddition(Quantity), CoverChange and CoverPlanningPort from its application port (docs/tdd/E27.md:256 to 293). Implement cover_changed(ctx, *, add_supplies) using ctx.snapshot/release/stock/at. E28 supplies instruments and holders to the same context; E32 only overlays stock. Preserve unknown packed values, used counts and request order; reject numeric/cover bounds with typed field errors. The what-if writes no ledger, audit, command or event.

Canonical E24 declarations live in this task's application/ports.py, copied exactly from SYSTEM 8.1 (docs/SYSTEM.md:1881): SupplyPartition(mission_id, environment_id, custody_location_id, origin_mode); CoverFact(supply_id, supply_name, quantity_now, per_use, cover_uses, quantity_text, per_use_text, last_use_id, last_use_at, release_id, stock_revision, source_refs); SupplyCoverChanged with event_type supplies.cover_changed, partition, cause use|stock_edit|release_activation|custody_transfer|recovery, cause_ref, observed_at, rows. SupplyCoverFacts.rows(view: UnitOfWork | ReadSnapshot, *, partition: SupplyPartition, after_supply_id: str | None, limit: int) returns tuple[CoverFact, ...]. Quantity fields carry units. Stable sorted bounded rows include every changed item and retain prior last-use evidence on activation. SupplyUseRecorded is retired. Use SYSTEM 5.10.2/8.6 isolation for E24 computation errors, preserving the accepted use plus durable pending evaluation and unchanged warning; storage/I/O/integrity/authorization/config/input failures roll back everything. No local evaluator wrapper or broad catch. Real E24 registration, start/activation/mode rescan, duplicates and delayed recovery must be tested; a fake handler is not E32-03 acceptance. Q19 leaves the shipped low threshold null; the SIM fixture sets an explicit labeled team default. Zero is valid and raises nothing. D1 keeps active warning pins across activation.

Use E32 5.1 sqlite_ledger/config_reader/verifier and the named migration, but SYSTEM 4.1/4.2 and 5.7 override its unprefixed supply_use/supply_unit SQL and feature dedup columns. Canonical supplies_stock, supplies_use, supplies_custody names come from docs/SYSTEM.md:110; exact unit-registry/head/clock-provenance schema mapping is request B02. Do not invent the remaining tables or store a replacement command_key/request_sha256 ledger. E01 StorageSession alone executes owned SQL, canonical decimal text with UCUM, append-only triggers and indexed heads; no SQL REAL for quantities. Every mutation declares reference-only ReplicationChange, including explicit export_projection=None when no approved export exists. Real global state/audit/outbox/receipt/replication atomicity is mandatory. The bounded verifier detects gaps/tampering, marks cover unknown visibly and never repairs clinical history or swallows integrity failure.

SuppliesReleaseCheck implements S-L1 to S-L7 from E32 8.3; ActivationGuard implements S-A1 to S-A3 in the activation UoW over every mission origin partition. Unknown/source-incomplete quantity is not a guess. Keep supplies without plan references, including example towels and dressings. Reject invalid documents, quantity reductions below used, changed units/consumability and removal of used supply/stock while retaining last good release; allow valid cumulative resupply and unit-stable reintroduction. config/kit-map.json, onboard-plans.json, warning-rules.json, skills-catalog.json and ui-copy.json are provider-owned release inputs, not this task's edits. Missing source_ids disallows the sourced label until R-E32-03 is accepted. Never hardcode fixture stock or threshold values into production. Register section 11 descriptors through the eventual owned module entry after B01; busy timeout uses platform storage settings, no local transaction retry.

API, copied from docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:8218/8283: getSupplyCover GET /v1/supplies with optional environment_id, 200 SupplyCoverView, all seven declared roles; recordSupplyUse POST /v1/supplies/{supply_id}/uses, SupplyUseCreate to 201 SupplyUse, crew/crew_medical_officer/station, Idempotency-Key required and Config-Release semantics. Parse generated models and standard headers, including declared Location without inventing a detail GET. Until accepted, R-E32-06 adds neither stock_text nor origin_mode JSON fields; use current closed response shape and pinned configuration text. Enforce the ConfigReleaseIn mismatch except the contracted help action exception, trusted run pins, active physical stock and reference visibility. Cross-origin/environment references refuse INVALID_VALUE under the existing contract, retaining refused help-use reconciliation under B04/B08. A station session cannot obtain chart access merely by naming a run. Use ProblemError mappings from E32 6.1 with SYSTEM 5.5, no private current_state. Current authorization and SYSTEM 5.8 replay lookup precede mutable preconditions. D6 overrides E32-T-16's same-key/new-mission expectation: a different semantic mission/origin is identity conflict, not a new decrement under the same actor/key. Use a fresh intent/key for a new mission action. Identical authorized late replay gets the original result or exact accepted_command receipt; a changed target/body/pin conflicts. No custom per-mission key namespace.

Tests first: E32-T-01 to -11, -15 to -19, -20 to -25, -30 to -33 and -45, traced as E32 section 12. Properties cover zero/negative/empty/max, unit/scale/nonfinite rejection, all cover-text cases, exact sums and monotone overlay without mutating used. Golden C20 cover equals examples/supplies/cover-lunar.json after the actual accepted fixture use. Test S-L1 to S-L7, null/zero threshold, no omitted inventory and failed activation. E32-T-15 pins a run across per_use/supply changes and simultaneous activation. E32-T-16 isolates missions/modes and uses the corrected D6 identity expectations above. E32-T-08 exercises real E24 and SYSTEM 5.10.2 typed failure versus forbidden failure classes; recovery cannot clear a newer warning. E32-T-07/31 requires real E28 semantics, not a copied availability engine. E32-T-20/24/25 drives real kitMapWhatIf through HTTP and proves a combined instrument/supply/skill transition and snapshot consistency with actual concurrent commits, no writes including command ledger. E32-T-09 is complete V91 through real E28 actOnPlanRun plus supplies/rule HTTP views, including final refusal/substitute. E32-T-12/13/14 compares identical supply API results at the same injected clock with model/devices/link absent (V81/D34 contribution) and static import restrictions. E32-T-30 edits stock, per_use, copy, applicability and a consistent threshold in scratch release documents, never level/authority mappings (V75). E32-T-42 exercises real E26 offline intent replay, unchanged help completion and one durable refusal; approved ground-log evidence awaits B08 without dropping the test.

AGENTS 6 fault coverage: process termination before/inside/after command and activation commits, storage/audit/outbox/replication failures including disk full, duplicate and after-24-hour retries, two clients racing the last unit, forward/backward clock corrections and mission boundaries, corrupt/missing configuration, null/implausible/conflicting inputs, changed lot/unit equivalents as applicable to stock, incapacitated/absent subject and denied reference access, and long link outage with replay in another environment. Every accepted record survives restart; no refusal creates a successful use or warning. No reading is averaged or defaulted. Own the backend end-to-end bodies in hub/tests/supplies; E21 owns registration. Done requires all those proofs and T3's assembled UI/complete D32 acceptance for the epic, not a supplies-only claim for E32-05. Missing B01 to B05/B08/B09 tooling/provider work blocks the relevant final gate.

Coverage evidence: the coverage command is E01 section 15's existing validator interface, with this task's unique temporary report. B09 must extend its measured-source inventory to the current E32 domain/application files. Require at least 95 percent branch opportunities per executable file, full condition coverage and complexity at most 15 per safety function, and the registered critical mutants killed with independent evidence for any equivalent survivor. Aggregate pytest-cov percentage alone cannot meet the branch gate. No missing/empty report or excluded file may pass.
gates: uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/supplies --cov=crew_health.supplies.domain --cov=crew_health.supplies.application --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95 --cov-report=json:/tmp/e32-supplies-coverage.json
uv run --project hub ruff check hub/src/crew_health/supplies hub/tests/supplies
uv run --project hub ruff format --check hub/src/crew_health/supplies hub/tests/supplies
uv run --project hub mypy --strict hub/src/crew_health/supplies

e32_import_config=$(mktemp)
uv run --project hub python -m crew_health.app.import_contracts --output "$e32_import_config" && uv run --project hub lint-imports --config "$e32_import_config"
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py interfaces generated trace safety mutations corpus
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py coverage --report /tmp/e32-supplies-coverage.json

Own only medicines backend, its two proposed configuration documents after schema approval, and all hub/tests/medicines tests. This is the single safety-critical medicines author; no parallel author edits this module. Implement E32 sections 3.4 to 3.8, 4.3 to 4.5, 5.2/5.3, 6.2, 8.4/8.5, medicine parts of 9 to 12 and section 15 steps 9 to 11. The directory permission comes from E32 section 13 (docs/tdd/E32.md:866). File/layer names are its listed domain model/dose/amount/gate/alerts/clock/ucum/ismp/context/config_checks/errors; application ports/use_cases/confirm/assessment_scheduler; adapters potency_worker/engine_inputs/anticorruption/artifacts/sqlite_repos/fhir and migrations/0001_medicines.sql; api router/errors. The directory also permits the convention-discovered module.py required by SYSTEM 5.12. Do not create speculative submodules or an export framework. T1 owns supplies; T4 owns medicines UI; E29 owns FHIR export, E25 next-dose routine and E26 help. The pharmacy package/configuration/contracts and root project are read only.

First verify B02/B04/B06/B07/B09. The design's medicine API/configuration shapes are proposals, absent from the package and contracts tree. Build pure domain rules from the frozen design where complete, using kernel types and tests, but no homemade wire classes or activated medicines.json/treatments.json. Accepted schemas, generated models, complete application DTOs, source registry and source documents are prerequisites for the affected boundaries and golden clinical cases. The research report named at E32:7 is absent; B09 must recover it or authorize equivalent independent references. No inventing doses, limits, sources or passing golden expectations. R63 and V99 to V104 remain proposed trace IDs until B06. E32-01 to E32-05 never depend on medicines readiness.

Types/ports: E32 3.4/4.3/5.3 supplies LotView, LotDecisionSummary, AssessmentRun, PatientMedicationContext, WorkingDiagnosis, TreatmentOption, DoseProposal, MedicationAdministration, AdministrationCorrection, LotMovement, DoseContext, PotencyEngine.assess(run, *, deadline_ns), DoseEngine.propose(request, context) and names-only MedicationRecordReader.active_medicine_names. Use generated approved request/response DTOs at boundaries, local pure domain types inside. Read current mission through E23 MissionStatePort, accepted SensorSeriesReader, E01 ObservationReader, E03 ProfileFactsPort and E15 EpisodeReader only through their trusted application ports. Missing B04 DTOs are a request, never guessed ObservationRef/SeriesSlice/RunContext. DoseContext reads release/treatments/bundle SHA, usable lots and completed summaries, all effective ingredient history/heads, structured context, two accepted weights, authority and corrected time under one snapshot; confirmation re-reads them in its UoW. Mission and LIVE/REPLAY/SIM partitions apply to every context, weight, inspection, assay, history and series. Anything incompatible is missing, never substituted.

Dose mechanism, E32 3.5/3.6/3.7: validate human working diagnosis and source/purpose/applicability, structured allergies/other medicines/organ/condition context and fresh plausible accepted kg weight when required; target fixed or per-kg, all ingredient unit conversions, interval/course lineage, synchronous lot exclusion, amount, stock, alerts and ISMP display. Keep every immutable trace document version/pointer or record/assessment ref. Same-ingredient/class/cross-sensitivity allergy, interactions, duplicate ingredient/class, organ/condition cautions and outside unknown amounts use the declared alert policies; missing required context refuses. Each ingredient's accounting is final amount times strength times max(1, fresh upper potency fraction), otherwise labeled amount. Compute remaining allowance across per-administration, catastrophic, all rolling windows and course/mission cumulative scopes; choose deliverable increments by worst relative ingredient deviation with deterministic smaller ties, then enforce every limit after rounding/compensation. An empty feasible set or target exceeding a remaining limit refuses; compensated capping states each shortfall and alternatives. Weight, lot, unit, stock, concurrent administrations or release changes force recomputation. INV-M1 to INV-M8 and no negative quantity hold for every accepted action. Manual administration is an attributed physical record, never an assistant action; B06 must settle its complete limit/exclusion enforcement before mounting it. Do not treat the design's manual path as permission to bypass a safety invariant.

Winning decisions override frozen text: Part A Q11 removes live_compensation_authorizations, M-L9 and external clearance entirely. The same adjust lot compensates in LIVE/SIM/REPLAY when engine/product gates pass unless the person asks path:labeled. Keep no do_not_use, outside validated range, low coverage, toxic-degradant or fixed-device compensation, product opt-out and every final-amount cap. Read actual decision.adjustment/flags and product settings, not assumptions that the six optional policy switches make every engine result eligible. Preserve engine findings honestly. Part A Q14 and SYSTEM 8.4 replace E32 3.7's labeled-only acting rule: use ClinicalAuthorityQuery.authority(view, *, person_id, subject_person_id, action='dose_confirmation', dose=DoseAuthorityContext, at). Copy AuthorityDecision and DoseAuthorityContext exactly from docs/SYSTEM.md:2147, including proposal_revision, recommended_dose, label_dose, compensated, engine_context_fingerprint, plan_run_id/plan_step_id/condition_id and pinned_release_id. Resolve product permission/training or the subject's active plan naming this medicine/condition through trusted ports in the same transaction, never caller flags. Acting confirmation may be compensated; record acting assignment and reason. Acting never overrides allergy/interaction alerts. CMO override authority is distinct from confirmation eligibility, excludes self and uses the configured allowed reason. The shared review-state decision in SYSTEM 5.6/8.2 and Q1/Q7/Q18 replaces a generic clinical-signoff dependency; B06 must propagate its exact medicines schema/test replacement. Preserve visible not-clinically-reviewed status, source validation and example/SIM restrictions.

Persistence: E32 5.2 describes the data, but SYSTEM 4.1/4.2/5.7 owns naming/atomicity. Its canonical medicines_assessment, medicines_proposal and medicines_administration are named at SYSTEM:111; the full module-prefixed replacements of med_artifact, med_bundle/med_bundle_activation, med_assessment_run/event/result, med_inspection, med_assay, med_context_statement, med_working_diagnosis, med_dose_proposal/med_proposal_event, med_administration/med_ingredient_dose/med_administration_correction, med_lot_movement and med_artifact_prune require B02 before SQL implementation. No feature command_key/request_sha256 ledger. Append-only clinical records/terminal events and expandable migration, canonical decimal text/UCUM, indexed subject/ingredient/lot heads, correction counted once without fabricating stock return, separate attributed return/waste/count correction. Every mutation declares local reference-only replication under SYSTEM 5.7; medicine clinical data has no automatic export projection. Bundle M-A1 rejects a removed/reinterpreted lot or initial stock below net movement, retaining last good bundle. Capture full immutable content-addressed bundle/manifest/input/result bytes before execution; rehash on read. Referenced artifacts persist for mission life; guarded pruning only for unreferenced run inputs past the registered bound, exposing replay_unavailable. No storage failure is downgraded into an estimate failure.

Assessments use SYSTEM 5.10.1 TaskInput/TaskRegistration/TaskHandler.execute/apply/discard and TaskQueue/TaskRunner only. No independent scheduler queue/status machine: E32 assessment history records domain provenance while E01 owns queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled leases/generations. Public kind assessment is legal only with approved endpoint/job binding and result_projector; if no allowed EvidenceKind exists return null, never a made-up result kind. Immutable input references and keyed fingerprints pin bundle, release, engine and source data. Execute outside transactions in E32 5.3's low-priority bounded spawn child, with memory and timeout enforced, no engine in HTTP. E01 handles recovery, attempts, cancellation and publication generation check. Schedule triggers on inspection/assay/bundle/release/interval with one bounded current intent; B04 must settle coalescing through TaskQueue without a local queue. Worker health/timeout/restart registration is required; process supervisor changes belong to E20. Late/cancelled/old-generation output cannot publish. Failed work retains the last completed summary while fresh; no assessment age ever lifts a known exclusion.

Engine boundary is copied from actual code: pharmacy.config.load_bundle(config_dir, schema_dir) -> ConfigBundle (pharmacy/config.py:307); canonical_json_bytes is in pharmacy.config:73, not pharmacy.types. pharmacy.pipeline.assess_inventory(bundle, inputs: EngineInputsDoc) -> InventoryAssessment (pipeline.py:1734) and replay(bundle, inputs, recorded) -> bool (1779); pharmacy.types.to_json and iso_to_seconds. Only adapters import them. Inputs conform to contracts/pharmacy/inputs.schema.json and types.py:988 to 1040: schema, as_of_utc, sensor_series, assays, inspections. Each series has series_id/sensor_id/zone_id/quantity/unit/points; points have t_utc/t_s/value. Boundary conversion to engine finite floats occurs only there with units retained in the series, not across hub domain ports. Accepted matching-origin observations only; canonical UTC/epoch pair through iso_to_seconds, no rejected point, no future point, equal-time/equal-value dedup, differing value excludes that entire series with a visible conflict. Do not average, truncate or invent a point. E32 11 caps each input collection/artifact and refuses input_limit_exceeded. Engine source data and existing config/pharmacy are unchanged.

Output mapping E32 5.3 and types.py:1636/1744/1763/1772: InventoryAssessment.assessments in engine order; each LotAssessment.decision has state/reasons/adjustment and alternatives; estimates join by ingredient_id. Use active-measurand quantiles, not total_quantiles for racemizing ingredients; choose lower/median/upper probabilities from engine settings, Decimal(repr(value))/100 to fractions, absent quantile means unmapped/no estimate. Preserve per-ingredient flags, estimate basis, assay IDs, degradant/validated-range/adjustment checks and exposure.coverage. Earliest crossing from forecasts, nullable when absent; status/expiry exclusions rechecked against current source facts at proposal and confirmation. ENGINE-SPEC 3.6/3.9: declared custody has declared coverage/no gaps, sensed zone without readings has gaps/coverage_low. An optional measured-history policy may narrow eligibility without editing engine results. Real assess_inventory/replay on fixtures/pharmacy/demo-moon-base.json proves mapping and reproducibility; do not tune any engine configuration/tolerance/pass rule to obtain a passing estimate.

Application/API work E32 4.4/6.2 only after B06: ImportPharmacyBundle, ScheduleAssessment/RunAssessment, RecordInspection/RecordAssay, RecordMedicationContext, RecordWorkingDiagnosis/ListTreatmentOptions, ProposeDose, ConfirmDose, RecordManualAdministration, CorrectAdministration/RecordLotMovement. Proposed operationIds/paths are copied from E32:943: listMedicineLots GET /v1/medicines/lots; recordMedicineInspection POST /v1/medicines/inspections; recordMedicineAssay POST /v1/medicines/assays; scheduleMedicineAssessment POST /v1/medicines/assessments; recordMedicationContext POST and getMedicationContext GET /v1/people/{person_id}/medication-context; recordWorkingDiagnosis POST /v1/episodes/{episode_id}/working-diagnoses; listTreatmentOptions GET /v1/working-diagnoses/{id}/treatment-options; createDoseProposal POST /v1/dose-proposals; getDoseProposal GET /v1/dose-proposals/{id}; confirmDoseProposal POST /v1/dose-proposals/{id}/confirm; recordManualAdministration POST /v1/medication-administrations; listMedicationAdministrations GET /v1/medication-administrations?subject=; correctMedicationAdministration POST /v1/medication-administrations/{id}/corrections; recordLotMovement POST /v1/medicines/lots/{lot_id}/movements; exportMedicationAdministration GET /v1/medication-administrations/{id}/fhir. Do not mount until actual approved generated contracts exist, including standard idempotency/revision/error semantics. No new routes based on the names alone. Proposed medicine.assessment_changed and medication.administered events stay unmounted until approved, with current per-object/field audiences instead of broad officer visibility. Job progress is E01's responsibility.

Coverage evidence: the coverage command is E01 section 15's existing validator interface, with this task's unique temporary report. tasks.title: Supplies components and assembled kit acceptance
tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, in that order, then all reads. This is a fresh-session assignment. The frozen E32 design is not edited. Read docs/build/E32/PLAN.md, including Design deviations and coordinator handoffs B01 to B09. The canonical docs/requests/E32.md does not exist at planning time; require its coordinator-filed decisions before dependent work. A request in the frozen design or this plan is not an accepted contract. Recheck the tree and every docs/build/*/tasks.json before creating an owned file. No hub, UI, eval or generated hub contracts exist at planning time; pharmacy is already implemented and read only. Never overwrite another coder, edit another task's files, add unlisted initializers, amend the product package, or copy a provider implementation. Propose missing shared changes to the coordinator; do not invent a port, wire type, table or command. No git. English, no em/en dashes or spaced hyphen dash.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock/TimeInput/ClockCorrections with corrected observed time and process epochs; 5.3 MissionClock for labels only; 5.4 Quantity(Decimal, Unit), UnitRegistry and accepted WireUnitConverter mappings; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and generated ErrorEnvelope on HTTP; 5.6 ConfigReleaseReader/ReleaseHandle, ReleaseCheck/ActivationGuard/TemplateRenderer and immutable pins; 5.7 StorageSession, UnitOfWorkFactory/UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot, DomainEventBus, audiences and atomic replication declarations; 5.8 CommandIdentity/IdempotencyStore/ResultVisibility/AcceptedReceipt; 5.9 complete reference-only AuditEntry/hash chain; 5.10 scheduler deadlines, 5.10.1 TaskQueue/TaskRunner generations and 5.10.2 EvaluationIsolation; 5.11 typed HubSettings/SettingSpec; 5.12 ModuleRegistry/register and startup phases. No replacement transaction, idempotency ledger, clock, retry loop or queue. SYSTEM 6 supplies uv --project hub, pnpm, guarded generated Python/TypeScript models, static discovery and import-linter. SYSTEM 8.1 to 8.6 governs canonical seams, guidance, object/field privacy, current clinical authority, local custody and durability; SYSTEM 9/10 supplies hard dependencies and kernel.testing. Backend features talk only through application ports. UI uses @crew-health/contracts and E03/E20 shell/offline mechanisms.

Write critical-path tests first. Fixtures come from opened configuration/examples through explicit test/demo profiles, never hand-typed clinical content or production fallback. Every test traces an E32-T ID and R/V/D or invariant. Every parser/rule/unit conversion gets property tests and every module gets a non-safety content-edit proof. Clinical arithmetic also needs independently sourced golden expectations. Bounds, external calls and subprocess deadlines use registered finite settings, never dropped accepted facts. No clinical text/value in logs, generic caches, fingerprints without keyed protection, replication or error bodies. Current object and field grants apply before reads, mutation, saved-result replay, event/task delivery and exports. Officer status and help membership alone do not grant a chart. The assistant cannot compute/confirm a dose or alter safety state.

Real-stack acceptance uses the hub HTTP API through create_app(settings) with real configuration/authentication/composition and a real SQLite database in a temporary directory, or Playwright against that hub. No hub mocks, dependency overrides, fake repositories, direct-SQL seeding or browser API interception. Optional external model/devices/link are absent or use documented adapter fakes. Unbuilt providers use their exact protocols and E01 kernel.testing during unit/port development only; those tests do not establish assembled acceptance. A missing required provider/scenario/tool is a blocked gate, not skip/xfail/pass. Keep independent provider counterpart tests. Done means all assigned test IDs, exact owned gates, shared contract/safety gates, independent review and CI pass with evidence. After a bug fix run the full hub/UI suites; report all failures. Coordinator records AI-USE-LOG.md rows outside task ownership.

Build only E32 section 7's supplies UI, section 1 E32-05 acceptance and section 12 tests 40/41/43/44/46/47/48, plus UI halves of 30/42. Owned paths are exactly E32 section 13 (docs/tdd/E32.md:870); tests remain in features/supplies/__tests__. T1 owns backend and its tests; E27 owns KitAboardCard.vue, ConditionRow.vue, PlanningCard.vue, Plan here/toggles; E31 owns trained hands; E03 owns shell/components/copy; E20 owns offline command journal. Read those provider designs and generated client only, never edit their files. B05 must provide actual slot/API/copy/queue interfaces and browser discovery before acceptance. T1 is the internal dependency; backend protocol/contract work must be available before dispatch. No duplicate card shell, readiness API, client session manager or offline queue.

Implement KitAboardSupplies.vue in E27's supplies slot and SupplyUseButton.vue mounted by E26 help for a configured supply; E32's design misattributes help to E11 but SYSTEM 4.4 wins. api.ts uses generated getSupplyCover GET /v1/supplies and recordSupplyUse POST /v1/supplies/{supply_id}/uses plus the provider's mission context, as in docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:8218/8283 and E32 6.1. Response SupplyCoverView/Stock/Use and SupplyUseCreate are generated from current closed schemas. No stock_text or top-level origin_mode until accepted R-E32-06; quantities already have stock.unit and origin word uses the same snapshot mission context. Backend cover_text and configured basis/error/designed-state/origin words are rendered; do not calculate cover, choose defaults or hardcode clinical/UI text. If view/mission origin cannot be associated safely during a transition, display unknown until refreshed. No typed derived stock/used/cover fields can be submitted. Use header-cell table, text state rather than color alone, E03 tokens, accessible keyboard use and contrast. No medicine screen or assistant shortcut.

freshness.ts follows E32 7: generation and applied_seq with each outstanding fetch tagged; a newer relevant supply.used/config.release_activated/environment.activated event invalidates and refetches; events during fetch and older responses cannot restore stale values. Stream loss hides current numbers, not merely a small offline label. Resume uses Last-Event-ID then a fresh generation; CURSOR_EXPIRED clears view/cursor and refetches/resubscribes. Do not compare timestamp with event sequence. Null, empty, error, offline and LIVE/REPLAY/SIM are explicit configured states, with no sample fallback. Use E03 shared event client rather than another SSE/clock implementation. Coalesce work within the provider's bounded mechanism, not an unbounded event-triggered request list.

SupplyUseButton records the person's intent via E20 owner/device-partitioned encrypted queue using the generated immutable Idempotency-Key, original body/release/client time/target. This feature never implements crypto/storage/retry itself. A 409 is accepted only when the exact SYSTEM 5.8 accepted_command receipt matches key/operation/target, never from DUPLICATE_COMMAND alone. Mismatch or changed context stays visibly rejected for reconciliation without a fresh key. Revoked grant/owner switch locks and quarantines original queued data. Failed use never blocks or undoes fixed help steps; zero-stock replay shows configured not-recorded status and backend refusal evidence. No client decrement or success before hub acceptance. Keep model/device/ground independence and cached help from existing providers.

Tests first: E32-T-40 uses approved examples and key-valued ui-copy to prove server/config words reach actual components, plus scan for forbidden literals (V75/V98 contribution); -41 no current number when hub unreachable; -44 axe/keyboard; -47 stream loss/resume/expired cursor, event mid-fetch, out-of-order replies and owner/environment/origin changes. -46 mounts real E27 PlanningCard read-only and proves configured or explicitly entered quantity changes add_supplies[].quantity without code edits; no literal 1, no sending empty quantity. -43 is Playwright against running hub/real SQLite: values equal getSupplyCover after actual accepted use/configuration change, never mocked response. -48 is full assembled E32-05: plain crew sees trained-hand counts (not private identities), every Plan here row has summary and ground-purpose text, all counts match API and frozen E21 result panel for D32. Missing R-E32-04/R27-3/R-E32-09 or result artifact is a failure, not permission to omit a clause. Do not reimplement E27 result/count computation. Coordinate E21's full D32/D34/V75/V98 bodies without copying or editing them.

Real-stack browser fault proofs include backend absent then restart/retry once, disk-full refusal, expired cache replay beyond 24 hours, concurrent same-supply use from two clients, revoked run/help access, owner switch during fetch/decrypt, missing/corrupt release, environment/origin changes and incapacitated/absent subject. Cached emergency help stays usable and no other person's clinical reference appears. For V81/D34 compare non-ground API/UI supply results with model/devices/link absent. Backend T1 owns durable fault injection; browser acceptance uses the real affected responses and queue. Done requires all owned tests and gates plus T1 real backend, provider slot/count/summary/result-panel/queue bindings and complete D32 evidence. Tests that require absent providers cannot pass via component stubs.
gates: pnpm -C ui/crew typecheck
pnpm -C ui/crew lint
pnpm -C ui/crew test
pnpm -C ui/crew exec playwright test src/features/supplies/__tests__
